'''Funnel plants''' grew on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. They were waxy orange plants that grew in two-meter-high spirals designed to trap rainwater to complement their shallow roots. They were used to provide water for [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]].
